# Exhibitions not to be missed in Bologna in the summer of 2026

Updated on 19 August 2026 From [Bologna Welcome](/en/blog/author/bologna-welcome--4)

## *[Check out the updated exhibition calendar for fall 2026; go to the dedicated feature->](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/blog/must-see-autumn-exhibitions)*

From **photography**, **contemporary art**, **cinema** and the great masters of **art history**, summer 2026 offers plenty of opportunities to discover Bologna through its exhibitions.

Museums, historic buildings and cultural foundations are hosting exhibitions dedicated to figures such as Frida Kahlo, Banksy, Albrecht Dürer, Agnès Varda and Luigi Ghirri. A varied programme, to be enjoyed alongside strolls beneath the porticoes and days spent in the historic centre.

### [Banksy Archive 01 – The School of Bristol 1983–2005 – Palazzo Fava](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/events/exhibitions/banksy-archive-01-the-school-of-bristol-1983-2005-en?_gl=1*1k712me*_up*MQ..*_ga*Nzk4NTg2MzU0LjE3ODUzMjI1ODQ.*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMjY2MDAkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MDAkajYwJGwwJGg4MzY4MzMxNTI.*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMjY2MDAkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MDAkajYwJGwwJGgw)

**Until 18 October 2026**

Not merely a collection of works, but a journey to the origins of **Banksy**’s creative vision. The exhibition reconstructs the artistic and cultural context of Bristol’s underground scene between the 1980s and the early 2000s, the environment in which the famous British artist’s artistic language took shape.

The exhibition is divided into **32 sections** and brings together over **300 works**, original documents and archive material. Alongside Banksy, the exhibition features the artists and key figures of the so-called ‘Bristol School’, who contributed to the emergence of a creative scene destined to influence international street art.

- **Where**: [**Palazzo Fava, Via Manzoni 2**](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/places/museums-and-private-collections/palazzo-fava-palazzo-delle-esposizioni-eng?_gl=1*1satnvz*_up*MQ..*_ga*Nzk4NTg2MzU0LjE3ODUzMjI1ODQ.*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMjY1OTckbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY1OTckajYwJGwwJGgxNjg2NjI4MTUx*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMjY1OTckbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY1OTckajYwJGwwJGgw)
- **When**: until 18 October 2026
- **Opening hours**: Tuesday to Sunday, 10.00–19.00; closed on Mondays

![](https://static.bolognawelcome.com/immagini/57/75/83/59/20260305154215.jpeg)  

### [Frida Kahlo. The Gaze as Identity – Palazzo Pepoli](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/events/exhibitions/frida-kahlo-lo-sguardo-come-identita-en?_gl=1*1q9xu2x*_up*MQ..*_ga*Nzk4NTg2MzU0LjE3ODUzMjI1ODQ.*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMjY1OTgkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY1OTgkajYwJGwwJGgxNTEwOTM4ODUw*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMjY1OTgkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY1OTgkajYwJGwwJGgw)

**Until 27 September 2026**

Frida Kahlo is portrayed through the eyes of those who knew, loved and photographed her. The exhibition brings together **70 original photographs** taken by photographers such as Edward Weston, Lucienne Bloch, Lola Álvarez Bravo, Nickolas Muray, Gisèle Freund, Imogen Cunningham and Graciela Iturbide.

More than a biography in pictures, the exhibition invites visitors to reflect on the way in which Kahlo contributed to the construction of her own public identity. Body, pain, clothing, self-representation and political commitment become the elements of a personal image which, over time, has evolved into a global icon.

- **Where**: [**Palazzo Pepoli – Museum of the History of Bologna, Via Castiglione 10**](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/places/museums-and-private-collections/palazzo-pepoli-museo-della-storia-di-bologna-en?_gl=1*kea7g0*_up*MQ..*_ga*Nzk4NTg2MzU0LjE3ODUzMjI1ODQ.*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMjY1OTkkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY1OTkkajYwJGwwJGgxNzUyNjIzMjQ5*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMjY1OTkkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY1OTkkajYwJGwwJGgw)
- **When**: until 27 September 2026
- **Opening hours**: Sunday to Monday, 10.00–19.00; closed on Tuesdays

![](https://static.bolognawelcome.com/immagini/87/88/a3/fb/20260316152644.jpg)  

### [Giuseppe Chiari 1926–2026. A Score for a Museum – MAMbo](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/events/exhibitions/giuseppe-chiari-partitura-per-un-museo-mambo-en?_gl=1*6trt6r*_up*MQ..*_ga*Nzk4NTg2MzU0LjE3ODUzMjI1ODQ.*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMjY2MDYkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MDYkajYwJGwwJGgyMDkzNjcxMzky*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMjY2MDYkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MDYkajYwJGwwJGgw)

**Until 27 September 2026**

To mark the **centenary of the birth** of Giuseppe Chiari, MAMbo presents the first comprehensive retrospective dedicated to the artist by a public institution.

**Music**, **performance**, **writing** and **visual arts** come together in an exhibition that spans Chiari’s entire body of work; he was a central figure in Italian art during the second half of the 20th century. The exhibition also explores his relationship with **Fluxus**, a movement in which he participated whilst maintaining an independent and personal stance.

The exhibition is accompanied by concerts and events dedicated to his musical exploration.

- **Where**: [**MAMbo – Museum of Modern Art, Bologna, Via Don Minzoni 14**](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/places/museums-and-private-collections/mambo-modern-art-gallery-museum-?_gl=1*4ezszu*_up*MQ..*_ga*Nzk4NTg2MzU0LjE3ODUzMjI1ODQ.*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMjY2MDMkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MDMkajYwJGwwJGg3NzQ4MDUzNjM.*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMjY2MDMkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MDMkajYwJGwwJGgw)
- **When**: until 27 September 2026
- **Opening hours**: Tuesday and Wednesday 14:00–19:00; Thursday 14:00–20:00; Friday to Sunday and public holidays 10:00–19:00; closed on Mondays (except public holidays)

![](https://static.bolognawelcome.com/immagini/57/8f/1f/3a/20260428160025.jpeg)  

### [Bernd & Hilla Becher. History of a Method – MAST Foundation](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/events/exhibitions/bernd-hilla-becher-history-of-a-method-mast-en?_gl=1*13arjcs*_up*MQ..*_ga*Nzk4NTg2MzU0LjE3ODUzMjI1ODQ.*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMjY2MDQkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MDQkajYwJGwwJGg3NTUzMTIzNzU.*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMjY2MDQkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MDQkajYwJGwwJGgw)

**Until 27 September 2026**

Extraction towers, blast furnaces, tanks, half-timbered houses and other industrial buildings take centre stage in this major retrospective dedicated to Bernd and Hilla Becher.

Featuring **more than 350 original** black-and-white photographs, accompanied by **drawings**, **books** and **posters**, the exhibition traces the rigorous method developed by the German couple. The buildings are photographed head-on, under similar lighting conditions, and arranged in sequences that highlight their differences and recurring features.

A special feature in the foyer also presents works by Andreas Gursky, Thomas Struth, Thomas Ruff and Tata Ronkholz, showcasing the legacy left by the Bechers to the Düsseldorf School of Photography.

- **Where**: [**Fondazione MAST, Via Speranza 42**](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/places/museums-and-private-collections/fondazione-mast-eng?_gl=1*7kbj0r*_up*MQ..*_ga*Nzk4NTg2MzU0LjE3ODUzMjI1ODQ.*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMjY2MDUkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MDUkajYwJGwwJGgxMjk5MjI3Nzc5*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMjY2MDUkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MDUkajYwJGwwJGgw)
- **When**: until 27 September 2026
- **Opening hours**: Tuesday to Sunday, 10.00–19.00; closed on Mondays
- **Admission**: free

![](https://static.bolognawelcome.com/immagini/cd/d3/5c/99/20260423020032.jpeg)  

### [Le Bolognesi. Well-known and previously unpublished photographs from the archives of Antonio Masotti – Galleria Modernissimo Cinema](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/events/exhibitions/the-women-of-bologna-well-known-and-previously-unpublished-photographs-from-the-archives-of-an?_gl=1*q5e04z*_up*MQ..*_ga*Nzk4NTg2MzU0LjE3ODUzMjI1ODQ.*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMjY2MDckbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MDckajYwJGwwJGgxOTY3ODM0MzQx*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMjY2MDckbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MDckajYwJGwwJGgw)

**Until 25 October 2026**

A stroll through Bologna in the late 1950s and early 1960s, following the faces and stories of the women who lived in the city.

The exhibition draws on an **archive of over 5,500 photographs** taken by **Antonio Masotti** as part of the *Le Bolognesi* project. Only a fraction of these shots made it into the famous book published in 1963; many of the images on display are now being shown to the public for the first time.

Amidst porticoes, bus stops and the streets of the city centre, the women in the photographs move through Bologna with natural ease and personality. The result is a tender portrait of the city, but also a testament to the social and cultural changes of the second half of the 20th century.

The exhibition forms an ideal dialogue with *Viva Varda! Cinema is Woman*, hosted in the neighbouring spaces of the Modernissimo Cinema Gallery.

- **Where**: [**Galleria Modernissimo Cinema, former Piazza Re Enzo Sottopasso Gallery**](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Galleria+Modernissimo/@44.4944856,11.3412149,1605m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m6!3m5!1s0x477fd550a60a92a7:0x94fc8dd853095a65!8m2!3d44.4944371!4d11.3436462!16s%2Fg%2F11rts2d84k?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDcyMi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)
- **When**: until 25 October 2026
- **Opening hours**: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday 14:00–20:00; Saturday, Sunday and public holidays 10:00–20:00; closed on Tuesdays

**Please note: Closed for the summer from 3 to 25 August 2026**

![](https://static.bolognawelcome.com/immagini/e5/a2/5b/ea/20260424164219.JPG)  

### [Viva Varda! Cinema is Woman – Modernissimo Cinema](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/events/exhibitions/viva-varda-il-cinema-e-donna-en?_gl=1*1bb5zt*_up*MQ..*_ga*Nzk4NTg2MzU0LjE3ODUzMjI1ODQ.*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMjY2MTAkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MTAkajYwJGwwJGgyMDQ5MjI0NTgx*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMjY2MTAkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MTAkajYwJGwwJGgw)

**Until 10 January 2027**

Director, photographer, artist and pioneer of the *Nouvelle Vague*: **Agnès Varda** is the focus of a 1,200-square-metre exhibition exploring cinema, photography, the visual arts and political activism.

**Film clips**, **photographs**, **costumes**, **installations** and **archival material** illustrate the breadth of her work, her perspective on societal change and her focus on female characters.

A dedicated section also explores the relationship between Varda and Italy, whilst the exhibition as a whole captures the creative freedom and curiosity of an artist capable of moving fluidly between different artistic languages.

- **Where**: [**Galleria Modernissimo, former Piazza Re Enzo Sottopasso Gallery**](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Progetto+Modernissimo:+ingresso+Galleria+e+Cinema/@44.4944856,11.3412149,861m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m7!3m6!1s0x477fd550a60a92a7:0x94fc8dd853095a65!8m2!3d44.4944371!4d11.3436462!15sChRtb2Rlcm5pc3NpbW8gYm9sb2duYZIBC2FydF9nYWxsZXJ54AEA!16s%2Fg%2F11rts2d84k?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDMwOC4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=97b44cf7-d74f-4f6a-9fd3-17db44fcab7a)
- **When**: until 10 January 2027
- **Opening hours**: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday 14:00–20:00; Saturday, Sunday and public holidays 10.00–20.00; closed on Tuesdays

![](https://static.bolognawelcome.com/immagini/a3/91/4f/92/20260306102937.jpg)  

### [Luigi Ghirri and Gianni Celati. Towards the Mouth of the River – MAMbo](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/events/exhibitions/luigi-ghirri-e-gianni-celati-verso-la-foce-en?_gl=1*yhg38l*_up*MQ..*_ga*Nzk4NTg2MzU0LjE3ODUzMjI1ODQ.*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMjY2MTgkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MTgkajYwJGwwJGgxNTA1NDUwODUy*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMjY2MTgkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MTgkajYwJGwwJGgw)

**Until 4 October 2026**

**Photography**, **cinema** and **literature** come together in MAMbo’s *Project Room*, which explores the intellectual and creative partnership between **Luigi Ghirri** and **Gianni Celati**.

The core of the exhibition comprises photographs taken by Ghirri between 1989 and 1991, during location scouting and the production of *Strada Provinciale delle Anime*, the first feature film directed by Celati.

Villages, riverbanks, roads and human figures make up a **poetic survey of the Po Valley landscape**, ideally continuing the exploration begun by Celati in his book *Verso la foce*.

- **Where**: [**MAMbo – Museum of Modern Art, Bologna, Via Don Minzoni 14**](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/places/museums-and-private-collections/mambo-modern-art-gallery-museum-?_gl=1*kg4wsn*_up*MQ..*_ga*Nzk4NTg2MzU0LjE3ODUzMjI1ODQ.*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMjY2MTUkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MTUkajYwJGwwJGg3NDI4NTY4NTI.*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMjY2MTUkbzIkZzAkdDE3ODUzMjY2MTUkajYwJGwwJGgw)
- **When**: until 4 October 2026
- **Opening hours**: Tuesday and Wednesday 14:00–19:00; Thursday 14:00–20:00; Friday to Sunday and public holidays 10:00–19:00; closed on Mondays (except public holidays)

![](https://static.bolognawelcome.com/immagini/9d/ec/71/41/20260514020048.jpg)

### A look ahead to autumn: upcoming exhibitions

Summer isn’t over yet, but Bologna is already looking ahead to the new season with a packed programme of events.

- [**Palazzo Albergati**](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/places/towers-historic-buildings/palazzo-albergati-en) will host **from 9 October 2026 to 29 March 2027** the exhibition [***From Gaudí to Picasso: Masterpieces from the Carmen Thyssen Collection***](https://www.palazzoalbergati.com/da-gaudi-a-picasso-capolavori-dalla-collezione-carmen-thyssen/), which presents over one hundred works from this prestigious collection to the public for the first time. A journey through the vibrant Barcelona of the early 20th century, via the works of the great figures of modern art from **Gaudí** to **Dalí**, including **Picasso**, **Miró**, **Rusiñol**, **Mir**, **Nonell**, **Togores**, **Torres-García**, **Julio González** and many other artists, exploring a creative era that contributed to the emergence of the 20th-century avant-garde movements.

![](https://static.bolognawelcome.com/immagini/46/35/4c/8c/20260803133915.jpg)*Pere Torné Esquius, Garden Table*, c. 1913. Oil on canvas, 49x65 cm, Museu Carmen Thyssen, Barcelona

- At [**Palazzo Pepoli**](https://palazzopepoli.it/eng/), the programme kicks off from **2 to 19 October 2026** with [***L’ARDUO CIMENTO. Living in the Mountains – Living in the Desert***](https://palazzopepoli.it/eng/events-calendar/mostra-larduo-cimento/), an exhibition by **Guido Moretti** which, through paintings, drawings and videos, reflects on the relationship between humankind, extreme landscapes and climate change. From **24 October 2026 to 28 February 2027**, the museum’s galleries will instead host [***Edith Tudor-Hart. The Spy Photographer***](https://palazzopepoli.it/eng/events-calendar/exhibition-edith-tudor-hart/), dedicated to the Austrian photographer who documented the social inequalities of the 20th century and whose life story is intertwined with the activities of Soviet intelligence.  

![](https://static.bolognawelcome.com/immagini/3b/1a/25/af/20260728175208.jpg)Edith Tudor-Hart ©Suschitzky Estate courtesy Fotohof

- At the [**Pinacoteca Nazionale di Bologna**](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/places/museums-and-private-collections/pinacoteca-nazionale-di-bologna-national-gallery?_gl=1*1vyh772*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTMxNTIxOTI1OS4xNzg1MzMwMDE0*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMzAwMTMkbzEkZzAkdDE3ODUzMzAwNDMkajMwJGwwJGgzNjc1NjgyMjM.*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMzAwMTMkbzEkZzAkdDE3ODUzMzAwNDMkajMwJGwwJGgw), from **2 October 2026 to 10 January 2027**, the exhibition [***Il cielo in terra. San Francesco e Bologna tra Cinque e Seicento***](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/events/exhibitions/il-cielo-in-terra-en?_gl=1*1x59wmq*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTMxNTIxOTI1OS4xNzg1MzMwMDE0*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMzAwMTMkbzEkZzAkdDE3ODUzMzAwNDQkajI5JGwwJGgzNjc1NjgyMjM.*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMzAwMTMkbzEkZzAkdDE3ODUzMzAwNDQkajI5JGwwJGgw) traces the evolution of the saint’s iconography through works by masters such as **Francesco Francia, the Carracci, Guido Reni, Francesco Albani and Guercino**.

![](https://static.bolognawelcome.com/immagini/2b/4f/18/ae/20260728120336.jpg)  

- [**Palazzo Pallavicini**](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/places/towers-historic-buildings/palazzo-pallavicini-en?_gl=1*vnbvdd*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTMxNTIxOTI1OS4xNzg1MzMwMDE0*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMzAwMTMkbzEkZzAkdDE3ODUzMzAwNDYkajI3JGwwJGgzNjc1NjgyMjM.*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMzAwMTMkbzEkZzAkdDE3ODUzMzAwNDYkajI3JGwwJGgw) also kicks off the new season with [***Leonardo da Vinci’s Machines: Between Genius and Innovation***](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/events/exhibitions/le-macchine-di-leonardo-da-vinci-en?_gl=1*vnbvdd*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTMxNTIxOTI1OS4xNzg1MzMwMDE0*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMzAwMTMkbzEkZzAkdDE3ODUzMzAwNDYkajI3JGwwJGgzNjc1NjgyMjM.*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMzAwMTMkbzEkZzAkdDE3ODUzMzAwNDYkajI3JGwwJGgw) (**24 September 2026 – 17 January 2027**), an immersive journey through faithful reconstructions of Leonardo’s famous inventions, designed for both adults and children.

![](https://static.bolognawelcome.com/immagini/9b/6e/de/d2/20260709020038.jpg)

- Finally, at the [**MAMbo – Museum of Modern Art in Bologna**](https://www.bolognawelcome.com/en/places/museums-and-private-collections/mambo-modern-art-gallery-museum-?_gl=1*a2y07m*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTMxNTIxOTI1OS4xNzg1MzMwMDE0*_ga_JJ7H284FHN*czE3ODUzMzAwMTMkbzEkZzAkdDE3ODUzMzAwNDgkajI1JGwwJGgzNjc1NjgyMjM.*_ga_B12M00RZ69*czE3ODUzMzAwMTMkbzEkZzAkdDE3ODUzMzAwNDgkajI1JGwwJGgw), from **16 October 2026 to 6 January 2027**, the spotlight will be on the duo **Cuoghi Corsello** with [***Tra le nuvole***](https://www.museibologna.it/mambo/schede/cuoghi-corsello-tra-le-nuvole-5769/), an exhibition project created to mark the fortieth anniversary of their artistic collaboration, which engages with the museum’s spaces through a new interpretation of the famous character **Quadrupede**.
